names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 16 februarie, «Sfântul Ierarh Flavian, Arhiepiscopul Constantinopolului».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 16 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιος Φλαβιανός Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντινουπόλεως», with the rank word and the see left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life: «înainte de acela, la Sinodul al II-lea de la Efes din 449, cunoscut în istorie drept „Sinodul tâlhăresc”, el a fost bătut cu sălbăticie și călcat în picioare, de unde, după trei zile, i s-a tras și moartea».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 16 februarie — «Sfântul Ierarh Flavian, Arhiepiscopul Constantinopolului»

feast.note: saint.gr closes his page with a note of its own about the day: «Σημείωση: Μέχρι τον 12ο αιώνα μ.Χ. ο Άγιος Φλαβιανός εορταζόταν στις 18 Φεβρουαρίου» — until the twelfth century St Flavian was kept on 18 February (https://www.saint.gr/3726/saint.aspx, read 30 September 2026). That is a former day, not a second one; the site keeps him on 16 February now, which is the day page quoted here.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 16ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιος Φλαβιανός Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντινουπόλεως»
